ideas.pitch: An AI-powered student support and wellness platform built specifically for university resource navigation.
ideas.title: CampusCare AI
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages multi-agent architectures proven effective at student support hackathons like GreenNovation.

ideas.pitch: A campus safety route-planning app that evaluates real-time lighting, crowd density, and historical incident data.
ideas.title: SafeReturn AI
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly targets student safety concerns on college campuses with high-utility geolocation mapping.

ideas.pitch: A personalized nutrition and dining hall meal planner tailored to campus dining menus and student dietary restrictions.
ideas.title: NutriCampus
ideas.why_it_could_win: Follows the exact formula of the Hour Hackathon winner by providing immediate hyper-local utility.

ideas.pitch: A decentralized micro-reward marketplace for tracking and verifying sustainable student habits on campus using escrow.
ideas.title: EcoCredit Campus
ideas.why_it_could_win: Incorporates autonomous transaction mechanics and marketplace dynamics that appeal to judges looking for novel economic implementations.

ideas.pitch: An automated risk-forecasting tool for academic departments to predict student dropout rates and resource bottlenecks.
ideas.title: RiskRadar Academic
ideas.why_it_could_win: Applies rigorous statistical modeling and regression forecasting similar to award-winning AI forecasting entries.
